Name: SleepyGenasi's Seasonal Taller Characters
Author: SleepyGenasi
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Tired of being taller than all of your favorite characters? Want to stop looking down into your Spouse's eyes? Look no further! There are tons of fun little features and details. Evelyn and George always match, Kent has a limp, Sebastian occasionally gains a frog friend, and more! Please make sure to check shout outs for credits to see which assets are fully my own design, and which have had some assistance from the wonderful Poltergeister's Seasonal Cuter mod. If my style isnt your cup of tea then check out Poltergeisters mod! Have fun no longer having to hurt your neck looking down at the stardew crew![/color][/size]


[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher and Smapi[/color][/size]
